effects: Only a Minter can call it (onlyMinter). Nothing leaves or reaches the signer's wallet: no tokens, no ETH, no approvals.
It records an optimistic-mint request (requestedAt = now) for the deposit keyed by keccak256(fundingTxHash, fundingOutputIndex). This starts the delay window during which a Guardian can cancel it.
It reverts unless the deposit was revealed to the Bridge, is not yet swept, targets this vault, has no earlier request, and minting is not paused.
formats.shown: "Request optimistic mint" with the Bitcoin funding tx hash and the output index as raw values.

findings.title: requestOptimisticMint: the depositor and amount the request is for live in Bridge storage, not calldata.
findings.evidence: TBTCOptimisticMinting.sol requestOptimisticMint: `Deposit.DepositRequest memory deposit = bridge.deposits(depositKey);`. The event emits deposit.depositor and deposit.amount * SATOSHI_MULTIPLIER. The descriptor can only show fundingTxHash and fundingOutputIndex.
findings.fix: None possible in ERC-7730. The hash and index are the right identifiers to show.

findings.title: requestOptimisticMint: fundingTxHash is in Bitcoin internal byte order, so the raw hex doesn't match explorer txids.
findings.evidence: Bridge deposit keys use the little-endian funding tx hash: calculateDepositKey hashes the bytes32 as passed. The descriptor has `"path": "fundingTxHash", "format": "raw"`, and no ERC-7730 format reverses the bytes.
findings.fix: No byte-reverse format exists. A label such as 'Funding tx hash (LE)' would warn the reader.

findings.title: requestOptimisticMint: case 0's description says 'finalization', but it calls the request step with a placeholder hash.
findings.evidence: cases/0.json description: "Request optimistic mint finalization for a deposit". selector 0x820b5513 (requestOptimisticMint), fundingTxHash 0xbbbb…bbbb, minedError "tx not found".
findings.fix: Use a real mined requestOptimisticMint tx and describe it as a request.

effects: Only a Minter can call it (onlyMinter). Nothing leaves or reaches the signer's wallet: no tokens, no ETH, no approvals.
It mints (deposit.amount - treasuryFee) * 1e10 TBTC, minus the optimistic minting fee (amount / optimisticMintingFeeDivisor), to the depositor recorded in the Bridge.
It mints the optimistic minting fee in TBTC to the Bridge treasury.
It raises the depositor's optimisticMintingDebt by the full amountToMint and marks the request finalized.
It reverts unless a request exists, is not finalized, the delay has passed, the deposit is not swept, and minting is not paused.
formats.shown: "Finalize optimistic mint" with the Bitcoin funding tx hash and the output index as raw values.

findings.title: finalizeOptimisticMint: the TBTC amount, depositor and treasury fee come from storage and are not shown.
findings.evidence: TBTCOptimisticMinting.sol finalizeOptimisticMint: `uint256 amountToMint = (deposit.amount - deposit.treasuryFee) * SATOSHI_MULTIPLIER;`, `_mint(deposit.depositor, amountToMint - optimisticMintFee);`, `_mint(bridge.treasury(), optimisticMintFee);`. All of these are read from bridge.deposits(depositKey) and storage. None of them is the signer's asset.
findings.fix: None possible in ERC-7730. The intent could say 'Finalize optimistic TBTC mint for deposit' so readers know TBTC is minted to the depositor.

findings.title: finalizeOptimisticMint: fundingTxHash is in Bitcoin internal byte order, so the raw hex doesn't match explorer txids.
findings.evidence: calculateDepositKey hashes fundingTxHash as passed (little-endian Bitcoin order). The descriptor shows `"path": "fundingTxHash", "format": "raw"`.
findings.fix: No byte-reverse format exists. A label noting the byte order would help.
